notes: No.7 (project "No.7"): the shared No.10 body re-skinned (skin #d69668/#b06e4a/#74422c, his own short dark hair #463428/#281c16, yellow "7"; MOTION_LIBRARY §4), same scale (98 px standing, ground row 102). Model sheet: frame "Side" (Side view, contact (73,102) = the Idle Side boot spot) and frame "Front" (Front view, contact (64,102) body centre). Each frame carries its own view. Reference / result view. Points are pixel indices (studioAnim adds 0.5; contact lands on the bottom edge of row 102). bbox = [x0,y0,x1,y1] measured on the art. Studio layer: Art only (numbers in Art; no Num/Ball layer, MERIDIAN plan §7.7). The ball is never drawn in a frame: the game draws it at ball/boot.
